law.title: Traffic lanes (B)
law.text: Where such traffic lanes have been marked, it shall be unlawful for the operator of any vehicle to fail or refuse to keep such vehicle within the boundaries of any such lane except when lawfully passing another vehicle or preparatory to making a lawful turning movement.

activation_conditions: the subject fails to keep the vehicle within the boundaries of its lane
exceptions: preparatory to making a lawful turning movement
residue: 'lawfully passing' and 'lawful turning movement' are references to other rules — rule composition
